about: Social Security's retirement ages as federal law in force (OPUS-GOV, owner's request Oct 12). Congress can change any of them through the legislature like any other law row.
source: 42 U.S.C. § 416(l) (full retirement age, as amended by the Social Security Amendments of 1983, Pub. L. 98-21, § 201); 42 U.S.C. § 402(a) and § 416(l)(2) (earliest claim at 62); 42 U.S.C. § 402(w) (delayed retirement credits end at 70); Social Security Administration, 'Retirement age calculator' and 'Delayed retirement credits'.

social-security-full-retirement-age.note: Born 1960 or later: 67 (the row's value). A person born on January 1 is treated as born the year before (20 C.F.R. § 404.102); the schedule is read by birth year as SSA's calculator does.
